statements.t: Going forward, our focus remains on completing clinical and analytical validation and preparing for company’s planned FDA submission in the first half of 2027.”
Based on current operating plans, the Company estimates that existing cash resources will support operations through the second quarter of 2027.

The Company’s development strategy is intended to bring quantitative biomarker information closer to the patient and make results available rapidly enough to potentially complement clinical assessment and established measures of disease severity.
The SYMON-II study is the pivotal study to validate the outcomes of the SYMON-I study, which the Company plans to use to support a 510(k) application to FDA.
Bluejay does not yet have regulatory clearance for the Symphony™ System, and we will need to receive regulatory authorization from the U.S.
